# `project.supply.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.supply.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.supply.set` (`SetProjectSupply`): sets one member of the project's supply; in v0 only its
origin, the external reference the supply comes from ("J-E-206-L", doc 20 §4.2).

`path` is one of `origin.source` (else invalid at `/path`); `value` is the member's JSON form, read
back into the supply type (a value it does not accept is invalid at `/value`); `null` removes an
optional member. Rejected: a project without a supply (a basic or macro project, FR-PRJ-026: the supply
is part of the project's creation), and an `origin.source` that names no external reference
(`CmdError::NotFound`). Only the project record changes. Outcome: none.

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
